alpha_definition: net_total_pnl - benchmark_net_total_pnl over the cell evaluation window, finite

benchmark.window_start: first bar where the cell signal is defined

conditional_edge.DISCOVERED_STRONG: MODERATE + COMPLETE full registered factor-family BH/FDR + q <= 0.1
conditional_edge.DISCOVERED_WEAK: >=30 valid events + finite direction-adjusted conditional effect > 0 + succeeded authoritative evaluation
conditional_edge.authority: mqk_research.factors registered FactorSpec + durable evaluation attempt opened before computation
conditional_edge.effect: conditional mean minus baseline, direction applied prospectively (higher_is_better, fixed ex-ante)
conditional_edge.factor_identity: family/condition type, params, horizon, direction, lookback, normalization, universe identity, data provenance, timing convention, information lag; results never alter identity

fdr.population: all registered factors of the corrected family; failed/non-evaluable stay accounted

conditional_edge.label: close_{t+h}/close_t - 1, diagnostic only, never P&L; labels reaching past the discovery fence are dropped

edge_recording_rule.non_qualifying: stay in the complete search/factor ledger, not registry records

eligibility_rule.requires: accepted registered SIP/adjustment=all provenance and supported asset/data semantics

execution_contract.fill: first bar strictly after t at rust_conservative_bar_range_v1 (BUY high+slip, SELL low-slip), integer-micros, same-bar fill forbidden
execution_contract.hold_semantics: desired while any qualifying event occurred in trailing N completed strategy outputs; no pyramiding
execution_contract.month_end_anchor: last canonical session of each calendar month
execution_contract.signal_knowledge: signal on bar t uses only bars <= t

flag_thresholds.cost_fragile: alpha - (strategy_costs - benchmark_costs) <= 0, i.e. doubling costs erases alpha

indicator_conventions.atr: simple rolling mean of true range

metric_definitions.concentration: max positive bucket / sum of positive buckets of per-bar alpha contribution by year / regime
metric_definitions.dsr: DEFERRED_FULL_POPULATION: effective-trial correction over the full population is infeasible; per-cell sharpe/skew/kurtosis/observations are recorded so research_multiple_testing_judge_v1 can run later
metric_definitions.exposure: fraction of window bars with a position held before the bar
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: peak-to-trough of cumulative net pnl including the zero start; flagged as a fraction of the 10000 budget
metric_definitions.sharpe: mean/std(ddof=1) of daily net pnl / 100000 over window bars * sqrt(252); null when std == 0
metric_definitions.win_loss: closed runs only; run pnl = net bars from entry bar through exit bar inclusive

ordering: families S01..S14 in grid order; symbols sorted; cell identity independent of order

parameter_neighborhood.neighbor: same family and same symbol, equal on every other parameter, adjacent in that parameter's sorted unique grid values
parameter_neighborhood.parameter_island: qualifying cell with >=1 neighbor and qualifying-neighbor share < threshold; never deleted

regime_definition: SPY close > SPY SMA200 at the prior completed bar (RISK_ON else RISK_OFF)

replication.basis: per config: count of evaluable symbols whose cell is a registry record (>= WEAK)

retry_rules.infrastructure_retry: same trial, new attempt, same economics

strategy_edge_qualification.DISCOVERED_STRONG: MODERATE + DSR >= 0.5 + complete authoritative full-population multiple-testing + PBO <= 0.5
strategy_edge_qualification.DISCOVERED_WEAK: common + >=252 completed evaluated bars + >=5 CLOSED round trips + net strategy P&L > 0
strategy_edge_qualification.common: frozen registered trial, succeeded authoritative attempt, finite metrics, discovery partition only, frozen costs present, valid benchmark present
